claims.interpretation: Rendered law extracts are not evidence of derivation depth. Only operators whose ablation changes the record (or makes it unresolvable) are counted; every other rendered operator is labelled PRESENTATION_ONLY and excluded from the depth and from any mechanism claim.
claims.t3_finding: In R26.15 the field rule_operators moved 1->2, 2->3, 3->4 inside the same fact group while the gold record was byte-identical.

limitations: Ablation is single-operator (leave-one-out); interaction-only necessity is not covered by this witness and is not claimed.
Necessity is relative to the frozen single-ball solver: it proves the operator is needed to reproduce the record, not that a reader will find it hard.
DERIVATION DEPTH IS NOT A VERIFIED DIFFICULTY MECHANISM. Its effect is UNTESTED and must be tested by E2 before any 'harder' claim.
method: Each operator of the solver-equivalent derivation pipeline is ablated in turn (its countermodel is applied instead of its test) and the instance is re-derived. A record change or an unresolvable derivation proves necessity; an unchanged record marks the operator PRESENTATION_ONLY. No language model participates.
